svg.title: Ten weeks: start small, then connect the parts
svg.desc: Ten weeks: start small, then connect the parts Every week supplies a starting point; you can join even if last week’s notebook is unfinished. Weeks 1–4 Calculate and choose Build small Python rules. Check examples and explain them. Weeks 5–8 Remember and coordinate Check incoming information. Save plans and track pickups. Weeks 9–10 Improve and share Change one useful feature. Let a classmate run it.
